as_told.title: Colonel Alexander saw two Nordics in a Las Vegas casino hotel

plain: John B. Alexander, a retired Army colonel, is said to have seen Nordics, beings in UFO lore who look like tall, fair, strikingly beautiful humans and talk by telepathy, inside a hotel casino in Las Vegas. The philosopher Jason Jorjani mentions it as one of Alexander's interesting stories. Jesse Michels says Alexander told him the story directly: he saw a couple of these Nordics in the casino, and they looked strikingly beautiful. If true, it would mean such beings walk unnoticed among ordinary people.
